one_line: Andhra-born farmer, geologist and nationalist whose flag designs helped shape the Indian tricolour tradition.

appearance.age_look: Looks in his late 40s to early 50s, lean and wiry with a slightly stooped, scholarly farmer’s build.
appearance.face: Oval, slightly long face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, a thin straight nose, deep-set sharp eyes with small round spectacles, faint lines around the mouth and eyes, and a calm, thoughtful default expression that shifts easily into quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed back salt-and-pepper hair with a receding hairline, kept close to the head; he wears a simple white Gandhi-cap style khadi cap, slightly soft and creased, sitting straight on his head.
appearance.costume: He wears a simple, well-worn off-white khadi kurta reaching mid-thigh with a straight band collar and long sleeves, over a matching off-white khadi dhoti wrapped in the South Indian style and pleated in front to ankle length, paired with a plain, thin, pale-cream khadi angavastram (shawl) draped over his left shoulder and across his chest; his feet are in modest brown leather open sandals, and he has a narrow cloth belt at the waist where the kurta overlaps the dhoti; no flashy jewellery, just a small black thread around the neck barely visible at the collar and a practical, pocketed khadi cloth bag hanging diagonally across his torso to rest at his right hip, hinting at his fieldwork and documents.
appearance.signature: A neatly rolled khadi flag with horizontal saffron, white, and green bands and a dark navy-blue Ashoka Chakra faintly visible through the roll, held carefully under his left arm, along with a partially unrolled parchment-style sketch of earlier charkha flag designs gripped in his right hand.

ref_desc: Pingali Venkayya is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 40s with short salt-and-pepper hair, small round spectacles, a white khadi cap, off-white khadi kurta and South Indian dhoti with a pale-cream angavastram, brown sandals, a diagonal khadi bag, and a rolled saffron-white-green flag with navy Ashoka Chakra under his arm and flag design sketches in his hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pingali Venkayya as a dignified, lean, medium-brown man in his late 40s with an oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set sharp eyes behind small round spectacles, short neatly combed-back salt-and-pepper hair with a receding hairline, and a calm, thoughtful expression; he wears a simple white khadi cap, an off-white long-sleeved khadi kurta with a straight band collar reaching mid-thigh, an off-white khadi dhoti wrapped in a South Indian style to his ankles, and a thin pale-cream khadi angavastram draped over his left shoulder and across his chest, along with brown leather open sandals and a diagonal off-white khadi cloth bag resting at his right hip; show him holding a neatly rolled khadi flag with horizontal saffron, white, and green bands and a navy-blue Ashoka Chakra faintly visible through the roll under his left arm, while his right hand grips a partially unrolled parchment-like sheet showing earlier charkha flag designs, and keep the palette dominated by off-white, saffron orange, deep green, navy blue, and brown, presented as a clean turnaround model sheet with clear front and side views in consistent costume and colours.
